question: V100-SXM2-16GB 的 HBM2 显存带宽为 900 GB/s，NVLink 互联带宽为 300 GB/s (bidirectional per link, total ~600-900 GB/s depending on topology). 对于 27B 模型 (NVFP4 ~13.5GB weights)，单次前向传播的理论最大 token 处理速度受限于 Memory Bandwidth Bound: Throughput ≈ Bandwidth / Model_Size_In_GB. 计算得理论上限约为 900 / 13.5 ≈ 66 tokens/sec (per GPU sequential), 但 TP=4 并行下需考虑通信开销，实际理论峰值远低于此，需引入 Alpha-Beta 搜索或静态调度以优化 AllReduce 效率。

sources.title: NVIDIA Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB Specs - TechPowerUp
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has paired 16 GB HBM2 memory with the Tesla V100 SXM2 16 GB, which is connected using a 4096-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1312 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1530 MHz, memory is running at 876 MHz (1752 Mbps effective).
